enabled.title: Enable Octopus Energy Integration
enabled.description: Turn on automatic scheduling based on your Octopus tariff

api_key.title: Octopus API Key
api_key.description: Your Octopus Energy API key (found in your online account dashboard)

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Your Octopus Energy account number (e.g., A-1234ABCD)

mpan.title: MPAN (optional)
mpan.description: Specific electricity MPAN if you have multiple meters. Leave blank to auto-detect.

tariff_mode.title: Tariff Mode
tariff_mode.description: How to determine your tariff - auto-detect or manual override

region_code.title: Region Code (optional)
region_code.description: Your DNO region code. Leave blank for auto-detect.

intelligent_go_start.title: Intelligent Go Cheap Rate Start
intelligent_go_start.description: Start of the cheap rate window (default 23:30)

intelligent_go_end.title: Intelligent Go Cheap Rate End
intelligent_go_end.description: End of the cheap rate window (default 05:30)

agile_cheap_slots.title: Agile: Cheap Half-Hours to Charge
agile_cheap_slots.description: How many cheapest half-hour slots to charge during (8 = 4 hours)

agile_max_price_pence.title: Agile: Maximum Price to Charge (p/kWh)
agile_max_price_pence.description: Only charge when price is below this threshold. 0 disables.

charge_power_steps.title: Charge Power Level (0-50)
charge_power_steps.description: Maximum charge power during cheap rate periods (50 = maximum)

charge_target_soc.title: Charge Target SOC (%)
charge_target_soc.description: Target battery level during cheap rate periods

saving_sessions_enabled.title: Participate in Saving Sessions
saving_sessions_enabled.description: Automatically export battery power during Octopus Saving Sessions

saving_session_min_soc.title: Saving Session Minimum SOC (%)
saving_session_min_soc.description: Stop exporting when battery reaches this level

agile_poll_retry_delay.title: Agile Rate Retry Delay (seconds)
agile_poll_retry_delay.description: Initial delay between retries if Agile rates aren't published yet (doubles each retry)

max_agile_retry_hours.title: Maximum Agile Retry Window (hours)
max_agile_retry_hours.description: Maximum total time to keep retrying for late Agile rate publication

saving_session_poll_interval.title: Saving Session Poll Interval (minutes)
saving_session_poll_interval.description: How often to check for new saving sessions

intelligent_poll_interval.title: Intelligent Dispatch Poll Interval (minutes)
intelligent_poll_interval.description: How often to check for new planned dispatches

intelligent_dispatch_mode.title: Intelligent Dispatch Mode
intelligent_dispatch_mode.description: Which dispatch types count as cheap rate periods

enable_export_tariff.title: Enable Export Tariff Tracking
enable_export_tariff.description: Fetch and display Agile Outgoing export rates

export_tariff_product.title: Export Tariff Product Code
export_tariff_product.description: Product code for export tariff (default: Agile Outgoing)
